name: Cloud Terminal at the End of the Sky
description: A lonely cloud bus stop floats in an endless sky, with one suitcase and a paper cup waiting for no one.
prompt: A surreal small bus stop standing on a floating cloud island above an endless sky, soft morning light, one suitcase, a paper coffee cup, distant floating stones, gentle wind, pastel cyan and cream, dreamy, cinematic, ultra detailed, no text, no logos, no watermarks
caption: What would you pack for a one-way trip to the clouds?
